This is authored detailed 2D combat art and Versus animation, not original PS3 model extraction or absolute1:1 certification. fidelityStatus=closest_supported; original references outrank generated design consistency sheets.

Primary Konami screenshots establish fitted segmented gray suit, tan webbing, gloves and left-eye optic; original PS3 fullbody frame900 supplies lower legs and dark boots. Fine pouch counts, hidden harness joins, holster underside, exact seams, stitching and laces are partly interpreted. No numeric count or hidden-side model geometry is certified.

Both orientations are generated independently, mirror=false. ScreenRIGHT exposes bare near anatomicalRIGHT eye; Solid Eye stays on far anatomicalLEFT side and can be hidden. ScreenLEFT exposes the electronic left-eye lens. Rejected A_RIGHT_01 risked a near/right-eye optic and is retained, never approved or repurposed as an OC.

The gray moustache is retained but its fine hair density and width vary slightly among small generated poses; elderly face/moustache, no beard, original hair and nape remain. Illustration contour/material rendering cannot be pixel-identical to PS3 low-resolution rasterization.

Original Mk.2 Pistol loadout, long dark cylindrical suppressor shape and NON-LETHAL HUD are supported by original frames2000/2100. Tiny engraving, exact rear sight, magazine/bolt topology and finger contact are not certified. No manufacturer/model beyond original-game MK.2 PISTOL is asserted. Original weapon fired/held by right glove with left support, overlapping support fingers can be occluded.

CH​AFF G. existence, rectangular HUD silhouette and physical throw arc are source supported at32000/32004. Cyan HUD is NOT physical color evidence. Small dark rectangular canister with short top fitting in C5/C6 is closest-supported authored readability interpretation; precise physical color/fuze/details and source electronic effect remain unresolved by these images. No frag sphere, detonation, smoke or damage effect is drawn. Root owns electronic Versus behavior and any separate prop.

C7 is a self equipment-check gesture, never an offensive eye laser, hard target lock or psychic attack. On screenRIGHT the near eye stays bare, but occluded far-side exact fingertip-to-optic contact cannot be certified; this drawing establishes a self checking gesture only.

OctoCamo source changes opaque surface material/pattern in original gameplay; transparent cloak/invisibility is not supported. These native gray body sheets remain opaque body illustration; runtime camo tint/pattern and balanced duration are root-owned authored adaptations, not a source1:1 animation claim.

CQC jab/elbow/sweep/grab/charge, walk/guard/crouch/jump, hit/KO, reload and exact phase timing are authored Versus poses. CQC identity and pistol category are source supported; exact motion capture frames, numerical damage/stamina/timings and one-pose freeze are not source-extracted mechanics.

Sources are untouched native RGBA1536x1024 with12 complete major body components each. Low-alpha fringe/residual background remains natively preserved; Canvas contour metadata excludes neighboring poses in close rows. No pixel cleanup, resize, horizontal flip, crop export, repaint or alpha editing occurred. Some near source-edge gutters are narrow but complete alpha>80 body and gear stay on canvas.

Standing source-height recommendations measure non-low native pose extents for fixed per-sheet scale, not canonical centimetres. Opposite-facing small design/scale differences and final Canvas contours, contact geometry, live gameplay/mobile and phase origins require independent integrator/browser review. Producer delivery does not certify those later checks.

Fourteen remote single PS3 frames, including searches of unsuitable costume/gameplay views, are retained. Only the seven named original-frame references above are selected; alternate civilian costume1200 and Otacon1950 are research only. No video/movie file downloaded in full and no source image pixels modified.

Approval here covers supported identity, full native bodies and equipment. Native authored phase choreography is a Versus adaptation; live crop, contours, launch and collision geometry require subsequent browser checks.

The visible Chaff HUD silhouette and physical launch are supported; exact canister color and original effect are not established by the selected images. Opaque costume keeps authored gray palette; dynamic source OctoCamo surface matching is not implemented.

limits: Newly authored high-resolution costume interpretation of the SAME original incarnation; original costume remains default and untouched. Target closest 1:1 source identity, not a certified exact original extraction or later-era redesign.

Same UID, authored moves, lore, weapon class and collision geometry remain unchanged. Costume choices belong to a match slot, allowing Original versus Next Gen with the same fighter UID.

Minor differences in cloth folds, accessories and pose geometry remain between independently generated facings. Details not resolved in tiny historical sprites are conservative artistic interpretations, not new canonical facts.

Original MGS3 PS2 Tiger Stripe fatigues and young pre-injury Naked Snake with both natural eyes; no Delta model, eyepatch, horn, prosthetic or MGS2 suit. Original PS2 whole-body render governs costume.

originalAtlasLimits: Selected incarnation is original2006PSP Portable Ops Naked Snake/Big Boss, navy/charcoal padded soft suit, brown/olive double suspenders, silver buckles, front pouches, pale waist edging, grey gloves and boot toes, brown hair and short beard. No Peace Walker Battle Dress/MSF armor, Venom horn/prosthetic hand or old MGS4 hair is mixed in.

Original full-body/face game character graphics are observed in an IA compiled artbook; official publisher origin of that compilation is not certified. Original source JPEG bytes, URLs and SHA retained; no generic project-generated illustration or early sketch is promoted as final canonical costume reference.

Right-facing camera shows anatomical left cheek and uncovered left eye; large incorrect near-left pink badge has been removed. Left-facing camera shows dark anatomical right eye patch and the single pale pink/white tag on anatomical right chest. Tiny buckle/strap adjusters remain. Fine patch-to-bandana junction is contiguous in some left views and is qualified closest_supported rather than pixel1:1 topology.

All72 selected native full bodies, both boots, complete limbs, bandana tails, straps/pouches and drawn pistol were physically viewed. Directions are separately generated, never a software horizontal mirror. Native output PNGs are unchanged and all earlier attempts retained.

A uses column groups idle0/4/8, walk1/5/9, guard2/6/10, crouch3/7/11, not the row-major action groups of PW. B uses3punch/3heavy/3low/3jump; C uses3pistol-special/3unarmed-throw/3utility/3recover. These are authored Versus phases, not extracted original PSP animations.

The MK22 inventory silhouette is only130x88. Fine firearm topology, slide detail, markings and suppressor are not certified. The visible unsuppressed short pistol is a qualified MK22-pattern adaptation; no exact suppressor or invented explosive equipment claim.

C_LEFT utility final source cell8 returns with empty hands after pistol manipulation in6/7; this is an authored stow/return phase. It does not show a visible magazine or prove a canonical reload sequence. C_RIGHT utility cell8 keeps the pistol visible. Utility emits no projectile and creates no new visible holster or grenade.

Source special gun group is shootC0..2 with an observed bilateral active-C1 muzzle. Super remains heavyB3..5 unarmed CQC, never shoot; specialDown must consume actual lowB6..8 melee rather than a legacy explosive projectile. The producer performs no runtime gameplay edit.
KO/hit aliases consume the actually lowered kneeling recovery cells, a restrained Versus down-state adaptation rather than original exported death/knockout frames.

Native rows are closely spaced. Read-only historical component inspector emits Canvas clipPolygon stencils for foreign neighboring fragments without altering any source pixels. Fixed per-sheet median upright standing height preserves lowered crouch/low/recover bodies.
This is producer evidence only. Root independent integrator receipt, actual runtime/mobile phase/contact/projectile-origin checks and publication remain separately required.
Public original artbook compilation scan is qualified rehosting, not independently authenticated original upload.
Generated action staging/timings, hidden reverse gear and small handgun/bandana detail are adaptations, not extracted PSP animation or absolute1:1-certified.
Original sources, rejected wrong-eye/badge and other attempts remain byte-exact and retained.

Source original PS1 episode7 frames1360 and1390 show yellow shoulder patches on both anatomical sleeves. Generated patch contours are illustrative and not exact source logo pixels.
PSG1 is the only weapon; original episode7frame1370 shows anatomical right trigger/grip and left fore-end. No permanent laser accessory, railgun, knife or pistol is established or drawn.

C-right shoot and focused optic frames use a more frontal torso with head/barrel facing right; screen-left rear grip/right shoulder correspond to anatomical right. This is a deliberate frontal projection compromise rather than an exact orthographic right profile. C-left independently depicts left-facing aim with the near right rear grip/stock arm and far left fore-end support.

Right-handed firearm handling is the canon aim target; free-hand jab/heavy/grapple and rifle-carrying during melee are authored Versus interpretations. Exact punch hand and elbow projection vary across illustrated poses; they are not original MGS1 boss animations.
Walk drawings are distinct, but exact alternating anatomical contact feet and gait continuity are not certified. The four native walk indices preserve all attempts and need runtime motion review.
Shoot/recoil, jump, guard, crouch retreat, sweep, hit, KO, grapple, scope and reload phases are authored Versus keyframes, not extracted original PS1 animation timing/data.

Reload frames show removal/magazine handling and receiver maintenance; exact insertion depth, empty-well state and charging action are an illustrative approximation. C-left recovery remains shouldered and stabilizes after shot. No claim of mechanically exact full PSG1 reloading footage.
All facings are independently generated; no native PNG is mirrored, repainted, cropped, resized or alpha-edited. Hair, cloth, skin and gun proportions vary slightly between drawings.

Root's additional read-only C-sheet inspection found red-looking antialias fringe with alpha no greater than4 and zero red fringe at alpha48; this is not treated as a canonical red equipment piece. Native antialias pixels remain preserved.

Nominal 4x3 layout is descriptive only. Bodies/gun muzzles can extend across nominal cell lines. Integrator must measure actual isolated alpha contours, full component crops, foot/pelvis pivots, muzzle/grip origins and fixed upright scale before runtime approval.

12 major alpha48 body/equipment components and zero alpha48 outer-edge pixels are measured in each selected native PNG. Small detached antialias fragments are possible; no clipping claim is made solely from threshold48 analysis.

Generated Meryl style-only source and prior Wolf continuity sheets are explicitly excluded from canonical evidence. Original archive videos were sampled remotely; local PNG SHA256 is verified, full-video SHA256 is not claimed.
Original PS1 and Twin Snakes UIDs stay separate. This delivery covers only core__wolf; historical V3 files and unrelated original source records remain preserved.

Ten authored moves share native groups: special/super share shoot; specialDown uses crouch; specialBack uses walk. Engine timing/resources/damage are authoritative. The laser line is a Versus target telegraph, not a certified PSG1 attachment.
Integrator viewed all seven selected canonical image files and all six native PNGs with complete hair, hands, PSG1 and boots. Pixel/model identity is closest supported, not absolutely certified.

Source C-right intentionally uses a partially frontal torso for anatomical right grip/right shoulder and left support while the head/barrel aim right; C-left is an independent native drawing. No horizontal image reflection is used.
Melee/grapple/gait/reload and phase timing remain illustrative Versus adaptations. Exact magazine insertion and gait anatomical contact alternation are not mechanically certified.

Fixed upright source scales are measured once per sheet; crouch, recoil and low poses retain their native shorter geometry. Muzzle points are approximate observed pixels for root-owned projectile drawing.

Normal punches/sweep/grapple, walk/guard/crouch/jump, hit/KO, shield pose, recover and exact move phase timings are existing CQC adaptations, not source-extracted original boss combat. The single optic pose is inspection/survey gesture, not a new lore power. specialBack uses authored existing walking retreat, no flight.

displayHeight240 and fixed per-source standing heights are authored simulator geometry/readability suggestions, not original certified centimetres. Runtime human hurtbox, positive scale and all phases/facings remain independently integrator-tested.

Existing Canvas contour crop must select the twelve reviewed bodies rather than claim perfectly noise-free original pixels.

Original flat leaf-flap ghillie, bald painted scalp, blue headset, white beard, bare hands, broad elderly shape, green parrot and original scoped Mosin only. No Delta, HD remake, modern sniper uniform, PSG1, railgun, magic aura or bayonet accepted.

Parrot stays on intended anatomical LEFT shoulder in both independently generated views, never becomes a second disconnected body component. Exact hidden vest/bag strap stitching, boot laces and the count of leaf flaps remain unresolved in low-resolution original evidence and are restrained authored interpretation.

Original PS2 firing image confirms right trigger / left supporting hands. Independent versus views intend the same rig. Finger anatomy, obscured far arms and headset-touch hand during tracking/reload rest cannot be certified 1:1 or exclusive canonical handedness.

All 72 body poses are authored bounded fighting-game adaptations, not ripped original animation. Normal rifle checks/shoves, low boot sweep, grapple alias, short jump, tracking, cloak, rest and reload remain Versus adaptations. No opponent or detached effect is baked into body sheets.

Both shoot and charge use the same original scoped wooden Mosin. Source muzzle is separately measured on C source global index 1 and 4 at first active action frame 1 for both independent facings. Root owns exact-UID gameplay correction from inherited rail tag to conventional finite-ammo shot; producer never changed profiles or engine.

Body scale stays fixed per native PNG at physically observed standing height, including seated reload/rest/crouch/KO. Rifles can shift alpha-centroid; independent integrator measures actual body/ground pivots and runtime crop scaling. No PNG raster resize, mirroring, recolor, alpha edit, cut-and-paste or external conditioning was performed.

Every selected native PNG has exactly twelve large alpha-connected complete figures and no alpha >= 48 outer boundary pixels. Tiny antialias particles and stored RGB under transparent pixels are left native; runtime Canvas metadata crops/contours only.

Rejected native attempts are preserved byte-for-byte: A LEFT 01 and 02 retained right-pointing rifles in some left-view cells; B LEFT 01 had mixed faces/directions; C LEFT 01 kept several right-facing or wrong-direction cells. Independent left-final regenerations replace only rejected candidates; no mirror or other incarnation is imported. Authored versus shoves/grapple and short mobility are explicit adaptations, not ripped original animation.

Body source scale measures crown/headset within separately physically selected head-column windows down to sole, so a perched parrot above head or extended rifle cannot stretch the body. Hidden seams/fingers and exact material/rig identity remain closest-supported.
